title: NIST WebBook: Ethane is C2H6, molecular weight 30.0690 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Ethane as C2H6, molecular weight 30.0690 amu, CAS 74-84-0.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Ethane, CAS Registry Number 74-84-0, lists molecular formula C2H6 and molecular weight 30.0690 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 30.0469502 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C2H6/c1-2/h1-2H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
